title: MANDATEGUARD RESOLVE PRE-EVALUATION DRAFT
scope: Unfrozen three-case smoke scaffold for a future 20-case synthetic offline engineering evaluation of bounded trusted-evidence acquisition after an initial REVIEW.
independence_note: The three product cases are distinct synthetic merchant/SKU scenarios. Failure injections derived from them are correlated robustness checks and are not counted as independent commerce cases.

evidence_policy.parity: Every case runs the product default evidence policy. The evaluator passes no top_k, alpha, retrieval-mode, or budget override, and refuses to run if any case's trust configuration differs from the product's.

cases.initial_evidence_gap: The registered merchant terms and product listing document neither the intended use nor the billing model, so the semantic verifier abstains on both constraints.
The registered listing documents neither the intended audience nor the content classification, so the semantic verifier abstains on both constraints.
The registered terms are incomplete, and the registered recovery source is also incomplete, so acquisition succeeds and the verifier still abstains.

int3_runtime_decision: NOT_INTEGRATED. The frozen six-query INT-3 evaluation remains research-only and cannot justify runtime planning claims; deterministic gap planning is used.
